**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 60 g of lightly dressed salad greens and vegetables on a 26 cm plate with about a fifth of the surface covered is plausible. Total estimate: ~60 g, ~25 kcal (wide uncertainty, since dressing amount is hard to judge).
